name: zombie-js-after-cdp-timeout
title: Settle zombie page JS after cdp_timeout (ISSUE-1)
description: After a Runtime.evaluate cdp_timeout the page script may still be running with no visibility. Probe the tab with a sentinel evaluate; if the main thread is provably blocked, Runtime.terminateExecution it; report zombie=killed|not_blocking|still_running|unknown through bridge and MCP diagnostics.
